limitations: Single trial per arm per case; unseen means not used for development/tuning, not absent from pretraining.
Raw uses repaired direct tools without Codali planning/routing/audit. Before uses original runtime and tools. All arms share model/config/budgets.
Client-only token accounting excludes Docdex service-owned inference unless separately measurable.
Shared installed dependencies and OS, not fully hermetic; service/model stability and host load recorded.
Service-health waiting occurs before attempts and is recorded separately from response latency.
User-directed output-cap amendment: 4096 to40960 for questions,8192 to40960 for apps. Live provider context remains65536;81920 cannot fit. Other budgets unchanged.
A separate full repeated comparison; previously exposed questions are not fresh holdout. Prior artifacts/failures retained and not pooled with these results.
Before now means build66 immediately preceding the numeric repair, after means build68. This differs from earlier studies using original build60 as before.
Scientific calculator improvements are also available to raw_tools. No answer-specific formula or gold values enter the runtime. Previously inspected questions are regression cases, not new holdout.
